name: Top 5 Countdown
description: A countdown Short on deep navy: a huge outlined rank number slams in beside an illustrated card drawn in code, with the name in tall Anton caps, a mono detail line, and a ladder of rank dots on the side that tracks where you are. Each rank gets its own beat: a whip cut, the big number slams with a punch zoom, the card slides up with its illustration and the name, the detail line counts up, and the ladder dot moves. Number one gets a bigger hit and a glow.
best_use_cases: Ranking the best of anything in countdown form
List videos with a big number-one reveal
